**Finding submitted — LICENSE: deviation (fails fallback).**

- **§ 2(a) grant (p0022):** licence runs to "Client" only, and "Client" is defined in the preamble (p0003) as Mortgage Logic.com, Inc. alone — no affiliate coverage and no written-notice path to add affiliates.
- **§ 15 (p0080):** neither party may transfer rights without the other's prior written approval, with a single carve-out for assignment to a financially responsible affiliate — so no successor/M&A transfer of the licence.
- Not walk-away (the licence is not revocable at will; § 2(c) ties it to termination under § 12), but both fallback elements fail.

Redline (validated, minimality ok): (1) grant extended to Client's affiliates on written notice to TrueLink; (2) a Client-only exception in § 15 permitting transfer of the licence to an M&A successor, drafted inside the existing consent carve-out to avoid a dangling conflict and without expanding TrueLink's own assignment rights.
